fills.prior_evidence: Not filled: the cleared timing described the abandoned North Creek line, and no source states a car-to-car time for the Wolf Creek north-ridge trip. The one north-ridge account via Wolf Creek (July 2020) gives only per-leg times (about 4.25 h to Gardner Meadows, 4.5 h camp to summit, under 4 h hiking out) over two days; a timing object would need a computed total. PEAKBAGGER PASS: The one peakbagger north-ridge ascent gives a 10 h time to the summit and 2 h 45 min down to the Gardner Meadow camp but no time out to the trailhead, so a timing object would need a computed total. Peakbagger ascent 2025-04-26: ascent Time 10 hours (trailhead to summit, with a camp), descent Time 2 h 45 min (summit to Gardner Meadow camp); no hike-out time.

No source states a one-way distance from the Tupso Pass trailhead to the lookout; sources give round trips (15-16 mi from the trailhead, 31 mi from the road closure) or legs (2.5 mi to Saddle Lake, about 2 more to Goat Flats, Goat Flats 2.5 mi from the lookout), and halving or summing would be computed. Hike page: 15.0 mi round trip; Forest Service lookout page: trail round trip 16 miles; lookout guide: 31 mi round trip from the washout, Goat Flats '2.5 miles from the lookout'; a GPS route giving 11.9 mi 'one way' runs past Meadow Mountain, a different start. Peakbagger Three Fingers peak page (South Peak is the highest summit, lookout listed): no Route #1 / one-way distance entry; selected reports listed, none stating a one-way Tupso Pass figure was found in the page summary.

No source states a one-way distance from the trailhead to the Gerdine-Cool col; sources give Glacier Gap at 15 mi and the summit as a ~7 mi round trip from there, which would have to be split to place this pin. Two parties: Glacier Gap 15 / 15.1 mi from the trailhead, Glacier Gap to summit and back ~7 / 6.5 mi, whole trip 37 / 36.6 mi. PEAKBAGGER PASS: Not filled: no source states the distance from the trailhead to the Gerdine-Cool col; the one stated one-way figure is to the summit. Peakbagger ascent 2016-07-02 gives only the whole ascent distance (18.1 mi trailhead to summit); earlier sources give Glacier Gap at 15 mi and the summit-day round trip. Placing the col would require splitting a stated leg.

Not filled: the only stated time to Dutch Miller Gap (4.8 h) is from the old road end before the 2007 Dingford gate, and no current-gate time for this line was found. The 2003 ascent report gives 4.8 h from the old road end; a 2020 traverse report from the Dingford Creek trailhead gives about two hours to the Dutch Miller Gap trail junction but no time to the gap; a 2020 forum report could not be read. PEAKBAGGER PASS: Not filled: the recent peakbagger reports from the current Dingford trailhead are bike-assisted and give no time from the trailhead to Dutch Miller Gap. Peakbagger 2026-08-07 ascent: biked from the Dingford Creek trailhead to the Dutch Miller horse camp, then hiked to the gap; on the way out camp 08:45 to bikes 11:40 and car about 12:30, but no inbound time to the gap and the bike leg is not this route's walking approach. List shows one 2024 trip figure (5,763 ft / 42.7 mi) only.

The crag's area page describes the approach (hairpin apex, Spire Gully trail, dry creek bed, slabs with a fixed line) without a distance or time. PEAKBAGGER PASS: The Washington Pass Ice Box crag has no peakbagger page (the 'Ice Box' there is an Entiat Mountains summit), so no approach distance is stated. Peakbagger search: 'Ice Box' pid 2018 is an 8,111 ft peak in the Entiat Mountains / Glacier Peak Wilderness, not the SR-20 hairpin crag.
